depot.bio: I'm a computer science graduate from Princess Sumaya University of Technology in Amman, building full-stack products and the occasional edge-AI system. I like projects where software meets the real world: a bus stop that decides whether to stop, a tool that explains why a link looks suspicious, a pharmacy system that keeps stock honest. I work across PHP/CodeIgniter, Flutter/Firebase, React and Python, I use AI coding tools as part of my workflow, and I care about shipping things that are clear, reliable and fast.

sdbs.title: Smart Dynamic Bus System
sdbs.subtitle: Flutter · Firebase · Python · YOLOv8 · OpenCV
sdbs.description: An enterprise-grade transit operations platform. A 3-role Flutter app (Passenger, Driver, Admin) on a real-time Firestore backend makes STOP / SKIP / EARLY-DEPART decisions using a capacity-aware algorithm. A Python edge-AI pipeline running YOLOv8n on Raspberry Pi counts passengers in real time; an SQLite retry queue handles cellular dropouts.
sdbs.demoNote: This simulates the Python edge pipeline (YOLOv8n + OpenCV). Not the real model — a browser demonstration of the detection and decision logic.
highlights: Real-time Firestore sync across 3 user roles
Decision engine: STOP / SKIP / EARLY-DEPART algorithm
YOLOv8n edge pipeline with offline SQLite queue
Immutable stopDecisions audit trail in Firestore
Digital transit wallet with append-only ledger

phish.title: Phish Checker
phish.subtitle: Python · Docker · Linux (WSL)
phish.description: A CLI tool that analyses URLs and assigns an explainable phishing-risk score (0–100) from heuristics. Dockerized for consistent cross-platform execution. The live demo below is a browser port of the same heuristics — pure string analysis, no network requests.
phish.demoNote: Client-side TypeScript port of the Python CLI heuristics. Paste a URL. No network requests are made.
